name: Huntington Beach Police Explorers
what_you_do: Learn about police and public safety jobs. The program builds leadership and teamwork. You also do community service.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 through 20. The page also says the maximum age to apply is 19. Ask the department which age applies to you. You must be in high school or a graduate. Keep a 2.0 GPA. Pass a medical exam and a background check. You cannot have a felony conviction.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
duration: Monthly training on the 2nd and 4th Thursday of each month. Volunteer at least 4 hours a month.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Start with the interest form on the program page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the interest form. An advisor emails you. Go to an information meeting. Turn in the application and a Hold Harmless form. Pass a medical exam. Then take an agility test, an oral interview and a background check.
notes: The agility test has a 1-mile run, sit-ups, push-ups and a flex arm hang. The city also runs a Fire Explorer program.
